title: RepoClean: Evaluating Coding Agents on Repository-Level Obsolete Code Cleanup
abstract: arXiv:2611.30350v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated strong repository-level programming capabilities. However, as software evolves, repository code may become redundant or obsolete, increasing maintenance costs and potentially introducing functional issues. Agents must therefore identify and remove unnecessary code safely, yet autonomous repository-level code cleanup remains insufficiently evaluated in isolation. To evaluate this capability, we introduce RepoClean, a benchmark of 200 cleanup tasks from 34 popular open-source Python repositories. RepoClean is constructed by automatically reintroducing deleted code from real repository histories into newer versions, preserving current implementations and retaining instances where previously passing tests consequently fail. To restore existing functionality without new feature development, agents must use repository interfaces and cross-file dependencies to determine which historical code

translated_title: RepoClean：评估编码智能体在仓库级过时代码清理上的能力
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体已展现出强大的仓库级编程能力。然而，随着软件的不断演进，仓库代码可能变得冗余或过时，从而增加维护成本，并可能引入功能性问题。因此，智能体必须能够安全地识别并移除不必要的代码，但自主的仓库级代码清理能力尚未得到充分的独立评估。为评估这一能力，我们提出了RepoClean——一个包含来自34个热门开源Python仓库的200个清理任务的基准测试。RepoClean通过将真实仓库历史中已删除的代码自动重新引入较新版本的方式构建，同时保留当前的实现，并保留那些先前通过的测试因此失败的情形。为了在不开发新功能的前提下恢复现有功能，智能体必须利用仓库接口和跨文件依赖关系来判断哪些历史代码应当被移除。
tldr: 提出了RepoClean基准，通过将真实仓库历史中已删除的代码自动重新注入新版本，构建了200个仓库级清理任务，以评估编码智能体安全识别并移除过时代码的能力。
en_tdlr: RepoClean is a benchmark of 200 repository-level obsolete code cleanup tasks, constructed by automatically reintroducing deleted code from real repository histories into newer versions, to evaluate coding agents' ability to safely identify and remove unnecessary code.
